commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
echo "HEAD=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "BRANCH=$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)"
echo "DIRTY=$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
git -C "$LA" fetch --quiet origin main
echo "ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main)"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path.home()/"local-agent/chat_bridge/manifest.json"
print('CHAT_BRIDGE_VERSION='+json.loads(p.read_text())['version'])
PY
echo "SUPERVISOR=$(ps -p 71830 -o command=)"
CTRL="$HOME/agent-workspace/control/.agent/daemon/control.json"
if [ -f "$CTRL" ]; then echo 'LOCAL_CONTROL_BEGIN'; cat "$CTRL"; echo 'LOCAL_CONTROL_END'; else echo LOCAL_CONTROL_MISSING; fi
ACK="$HOME/agent-workspace/control/.agent/daemon/acks/chatgpt-local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-self-update-20260903-0121.json"
if [ -f "$ACK" ]; then echo 'LOCAL_ACK_BEGIN'; cat "$ACK"; echo 'LOCAL_ACK_END'; else echo LOCAL_ACK_MISSING; fi
commands.output:
HEAD=f1709acd7080ecba191d7a266f332977417f685f
BRANCH=main
DIRTY=0

CHAT_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.3.2

LOCAL_CONTROL_MISSING
LOCAL_ACK_MISSING
